dialog.message: Pair your smartphone via Bluetooth to the vehicle touchscreen in phone settings.
Visit UconnectPhone.com for smartphone compatibility with your Uconnect system.
Download the Uconnect Access app to your smartphone from the App Store or Google Play. Log in to the app with your Mopar Owner Connect account.
Via Mobile uses the Uconnect Access app and your smartphone's data plan to access Uconnect-enabled apps from the vehicle.
Link your account to your Via Mobile Profile on MoparOwnerConnect.com so you can access your saved stations and settings.
For more information on Via Mobile apps, press ASSIST or call Uconnect Care USA 1-855-792-4241 Canada 1-855-209-8317 or Visit DriveUconnect.com
